name: SM4 File Encryption
description: Encrypt a whole file in chunks, suitable for large files; the output uses a custom container format.

examples.label: Encrypt a file with SM4
examples.value: Pick a file and encrypt it with the test key

examples.label: Decrypt a file with SM4
examples.value: Pick a .sm4 container and decrypt it

hints.nonce: Leave it empty to let the server generate a random base nonce; per-chunk nonces are derived from it.
hints.chunkSize: The chunk size drives memory usage (about 2×) and is independent of the file size.
hints.file: Files are processed on the server and never written to disk; only a download link is returned.

faq.q: How large a file can I process?

faq.a: No. This tool uses the custom TBFC container format.

faq.q: What if decryption reports a wrong key?
faq.a: Make sure the key matches the one used for encryption; per-chunk authentication detects any tampering.
No. Files are streamed in memory, never written to disk, logs or statistics.
